Select A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME As AC_REFBY,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.AC_GR = ' ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? and A.VCH_DATE = ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO ORDER BY B.AC_NAME

' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ?

Select B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE As AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,A.LDR_NAME, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver,B.MAIN_BOOK FROM (AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE And A.LD_CODE = C.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.LEDR_KEY,A.LD_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK,A.LDR_NAME ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME

' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY B.BOOK_NAME,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_CODE,C.AC_NAME,C.AC_ADD1,C.AC_MOBILE,B.MAIN_BOOK ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,B.BOOK_NAME,A.VCH_NO
